name: Dr. J. McGuire, physician

proprietors.name: John McGuire
proprietors.basis: ADOPTED, NOT MINTED. John McGuire is the reconstructed trade head the resident band's `trade_households` stage drew at physician in the south division (slot trade_households:persons/male/30_39/south/family/trade:physician:032), and that card says itself that the business band adopts these heads rather than minting its own. One quota, filled once: this house is the establishment that head keeps.

locations.basis: A FACE, NOT A PREMISES. The placement rule for a physician kept by a south-division household deals this house onto South Water Street; the face is drawn on the seed printed in `reconstruction.seed` from the faces that rule allows, and no lot, roof or coordinate is claimed. T-1195 writes the placement policy with its evidence and T-1199 seats this house on the lot grid.
locations.limit_reason: No source places this house, because no source names it: it exists because the December 1835 State census counts more of its class than the register holds. The street is the reconstruction's own deal and stops there.

dates.basis: NOTHING DATES THIS HOUSE. The census that orders it was taken in December 1835 and counts a standing trade, not an opening; the record claims that the house was trading on 1835-07-01 and nothing about either end.

proprietor_community.basis: The 1 keeper(s) this record names and the resident layer holds a card for all read irish: John McGuire (irish). A house is not its keeper, so the reading is an inference about the house and is capped there.

replaceable_by: A register, directory or deed naming a real house of this class in the south division in 1835 — that house takes this slot and this record is withdrawn.

basis.note: the December 1835 State census prints 14 — a line that counts MEN and not premises (T-1007). The town holds 8 of them at the scene date against 8 register records, and the scene date's population brackets the class between 9 and 13. The book orders to the low end, 9. The book leaves 1 of this class to reconstruct and this is one of them. The style is dealt on the seed printed beside it from the period forms the register itself carries: the form 'Dr. W. G. Austin, botanic physician' prints — the same, with the practice's line after it. The goods line is the trade line the register prints under Dr. J. H. Barnard.

reconstruction.withdrawn_if: a source naming a real house of this class, or a re-cut of the order book that no longer orders this bucket; the retirement runs through --build, never by hand
